hints.customTypes: Custom codes are allowed for catalog experiments. Until type attributes live on site_types, they behave like TENT (camping): optional rig length, driveway allowed, stay under camping search — and they are not guest-filterable by fine type.

errors.codeRequired: Site type code is required but was not provided.
errors.codeTooLong: Site type code must be {max} characters or fewer.
errors.codeInvalidFormat: Site type code must start with a letter and use only A–Z, digits, and underscores (e.g. RV_AND_TENT).
errors.systemCodeProtected: {codes} are used by site forms, guest search, and database rules and cannot be deleted.

badges.systemTitle: {codes} are protected system codes and cannot be deleted.

actions.confirmSiteTypeDeletion: Delete site type "{code}"? This action cannot be undone.
